name: Proposed LetBuyy legacy public entry redirects

rules.description: Proposed exact legacy public root redirect
rules.expression: (http.host eq "seller.letbuyy.com") and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}

rules.description: Proposed exact legacy public root redirect
rules.expression: (http.host in {"developer.letbuyy.com" "developers.letbuyy.com"}) and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}
